rules_secondary:
The market will close at 11:59 PM ET on December 31, 2023. The market will expire at the sooner of the first 10:00 AM following the release of the data for 2023, or 10:00 AM ET March 31, 2024.

At the Source Agency link, use the value in the No_Smoothing column.

Clarification 7/18/23 9:39 AM ET: Recently, NASA updated Land-Ocean Temperature Index values for previous years. This included revising down 2020 from 1.02 degrees Celsius to 1.01 degrees Celsius, making the hottest year on record slightly cooler. The 2023 global average temperature market will resolve based on whether or not 2023's value is greater than 1.02, as its rules say.
